{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute average revenue per completed order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean().round(2)

# Extract values
total_email_revenue = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['revenue'].sum()
total_paid_search_revenue = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue'].sum()

# Confirm the population: completed, non-QA orders
n_email = len(df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email'])
n_paid_search = len(df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search'])

print(f'Number of completed, non-QA orders in email channel: {n_email}')
print(f'Number of completed, non-QA orders in paid_search channel: {n_paid_search}')
print(f'Average revenue per order (email): {avg_revenue_by_channel["email"]:.2f} USD')
print(f'Average revenue per order (paid_search): {avg_revenue_by_channel["paid_search"]:.2f} USD')
print(f'Total revenue (email): {total_email_revenue:.2f} USD')
print(f'Total revenue (paid_search): {total_paid_search_revenue:.2f} USD')"}
